name: ModelVariant166_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant166_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (particles rise straight from one of the slot's parts, pulse around their targets, gather onto a point next to the other slot and burst out again behind a glow, a ring and a fading screen flash); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request modulo 100, seeds the particle targets and packs five texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 until the gather ends, 2 once the burst has run out, 1 once when the gather ends and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-183 and 313 images build it from the same source and bind its data names 0x24 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
